entry.title: Indonesia delays halal law again: Will industry ever be ready?
entry.summary: Indonesia has delayed implementation of its halal regulations once again

entry.title: Japan-Singapore MOU: Targeting climate-resilient food supplies
entry.summary: Japan and Singapore will expand food-tech cooperation to address climate change and food-supply challenges, with an MOU announcement scheduled for October 29.

entry.title: GLP-1 and taste: How it could reshape beverage reformulation
entry.summary: As GLP-1 medications influence eating habits and nutritional priorities, beverage manufacturers are exploring new approaches to hydration, flavour modulation and nutrient enrichment while balancing functionality with taste and sensory appeal.

entry.title: Debunking snacking as we know it
entry.summary: Circana’s Ananda Roy explains why snack manufacturers need to look beyond healthier recipes to changing meal habits, retail placement and new competitors.

entry.title: Why açaí has gone global
entry.summary: Açaí, a purple berry used in desserts and drinks, is produced almost exclusively in Brazil. Yet consumption has gone global, with consumers in North America, Asia and Europe all embracing it.

entry.title: Danone delivers a strong Q3 performance
entry.summary: Danone’s Q3 growth was fuelled by strong demand for high-protein, gut health and medical nutrition products across key global markets

entry.title: Forget flavour, texture’s transforming confectionery
entry.summary: Texture is emerging as confectionery’s next innovation frontier. From sugar reduction and functional ingredients to AI-powered product development, manufacturers are rethinking crunch, chew and mouthfeel to create the next generation of confectionery experiences.

entry.title: Dairy Farmers of America closes in on Nestlé in global dairy rankings
entry.summary: Dairy Farmers of America could overtake Nestlé in global dairy sales, RaboResearch says, as acquisitions reshape its Global Dairy Top 20.

entry.title: European consumers see potential in innovative foods – but remain cautious
entry.summary: Innovative foods - foods made using advanced technologies - still attract a lot of scepticism among European consumers. Yet many see their potential, and some are open to trying them within certain parameters.

entry.title: Nestlé targets two booming beverage trends with latest launch
entry.summary: Nestlé expands Sanpellegrino Zero Added Sugar range with Strawberry Crema, blending dessert-inspired flavour with functional benefits. The low-calorie launch reflects growing demand for premium soft drinks that combine indulgence, wellness and reduced sugar credentials.

entry.title: No cows, no questions: FDA greenlights animal-free casein
entry.summary: Those Vegan Cowboys and Formo receive an FDA no-questions letter for precision-fermented casein, advancing plans for US food and nutrition products.

entry.title: New Hope taps Norwegian Red genetics for China’s premium milk market
entry.summary: China’s New Hope Dairy is using Norwegian Red cattle genetics to differentiate its premium milk range, in a partnership with Norwegian breeding company Geno

entry.title: APAC Global Food Tech Awards 2026 spotlights food waste, compliance and functional foods
entry.summary: South Korea’s FutureSense won the 2026 APAC Global Food Tech Awards for its food waste-tracking platform, while finalists from Australia and Taiwan focused on regulatory compliance and plant-based functional ingredients respectively.

entry.title: Nestlé tackles regenerative agriculture’s missing piece
entry.summary: Nestlé and BirdLife Europe launch three-and-a-half-year project to measure how regenerative agriculture impacts biodiversity, signalling a broader shift beyond soil health and carbon towards ecosystem restoration.

entry.title: Beyond candy: Halloween displays expand across store aisles
entry.summary: As Halloween evolves into a three-month shopping season, retailers are expanding cross-category displays and adding better-for-you treats to capture early demand.

entry.title: New cocoa powder alternative targets GLP-1 trends and supply risks
entry.summary: Planet A Foods launches Cocoa Booster, a high-fiber cocoa powder replacer that can replace up to 100% of cocoa in select applications amid rising costs and GLP-1-driven demand shifts.

entry.title: Albertsons argues executive greed at Kroger killed the deal
entry.summary: Albertsons alleges Kroger’s $400 million executive incentive plan undermined their failed merger. Inside the $9 billion lawsuit and grocery industry fallout.

entry.title: European summer gives the Magnum Ice Cream Company a boost in Q3
entry.summary: The Magnum Ice Cream Company has reported a strong Q3, boosted in part by the extended European summer. The company saw significant growth in key brands, with Magnum and Heartbrand in double-digit growth.

entry.title: Mondelēz turns Toblerone into flavour innovation engine
entry.summary: Toblerone has launched a limited-edition Pistachio Gelato flavour at Istanbul Airport as Mondelēz leans into flavour innovation, travel retail exclusives and destination-inspired confectionery.
